people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

translations.web: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
translations.bsb: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
translations.kjv: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
translations.asv: And Jehovah God called unto the man, and said unto him, Where art thou?
